intro.title: Find suppliers for your purchases
intro.text: Upload a CSV with procurement notices. For every purchase the system identifies the products, finds companies and shows what each conclusion rests on. The decision stays with you.
intro.formatText: CSV in UTF-8 or Windows-1251, separated by “;” or “,”. One row is one lot; the first row holds the column names.
intro.privacy: No external neural network APIs are used.

drop.title: Drop the CSV here
drop.hint: or choose a file on your computer

list.title: Uploads
list.caption: Open a file to see its purchases and recommendations.
list.rejected_one: {{count}} row with errors was not processed

list.notStored: Will be lost after a reload: the browser ran out of space.

dialog.title: New upload
dialog.noValid: The file has no rows that can be processed. Fix the errors and upload the file again.
dialog.issuesNote: These rows will not be processed; the rest will. Fix the errors in the file and upload it again to add the skipped purchases.
